botCheckTriggered: [zerochan] The site bot check was triggered; fetching the cookie: {url}
botCheckNoCookie: [zerochan] The bot-check response had no Set-Cookie; later requests may still be blocked
listContainerMissing: [zerochan] The page has no post list container; the site may have blocked the request or the tag does not exist: {url}
searchNotMatched: [zerochan] The search term did not match any site tag, so the site stayed on /search: {url}
pagePostCount: [zerochan] Page {page} has {count} post(s) (the site shows {perPage} per page; anonymous visitors see fewer)
imageMissing: [zerochan] No image URL was found on the detail page; skipping: {url}
endPageBeforeStart: The end page must not be before the start page
pageRangeTooLarge: A single run cannot crawl more than 100 pages. Please crawl responsibly
tagRequired: Tag mode requires a site tag, for example Arknights
searchRequired: Search mode requires a search term
